errors.text: The proposed cryo-rolling and partial-annealing route does not reconstruct the target 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2 h HPHT intervention.

The proposed control is not processing-matched: Batch A is cryo-rolled before annealing, whereas Batch B is described as standard annealing only, so differences cannot be uniquely attributed to hierarchical partial recrystallization.
The hypothesis combines coarse/fine grains, coherent precipitates, and low-SFE twinning from different alloy systems as though all features will coexist in an unspecified target composition.
